note: Candidate bases for the bottled SQL rung. A candidate replaces qwen3-4b only if tools/bottling/swap_base.py compare says it beats it on the same held-out questions. Download rule: only if the weights are < 2 GB; otherwise the swap path (AGERE_BOTTLED_BASE) and the harness are ready and the model is fetched when allowed.

omnisql-7b.paper: OmniSQL (Li et al., 2025): synthesised text2SQL data; 7B beats GPT-4o on BIRD/Spider variants

arctic-text2sql-r1-7b.paper: Arctic-Text2SQL-R1 (Snowflake, 2025): execution-reward RL; needs an MLX 4-bit conversion (mlx_lm.convert -q)
